explanation: Mathlib has general results such as `LinearMap.BilinForm.dualSubmodule_span_of_basis` and `Submodule.traceDual_span_of_basis`, but neither states the identification of the dual of this mixed-embedding ideal lattice with the embedded fractional-ideal dual. Obtaining the target requires combining those results with the number-field embedding and lattice identifications, so it is not a duplicate or a one- or two-line special case of a single declaration.
